name: Miss Friedman
role: Summer 1884 visitor at the Sloping Bottom ranch
bio: Miss Friedman spent part of summer 1884 visiting the Sloping Bottom ranch and attended local gatherings with the Roberts family. She left for Mandan in early August 1884.

moments.label: Left for Mandan after a ranch visit
